name: What If Lab
promise: Ridiculous questions, answered with real numbers.

audience.who: people who share odd facts with friends

tone.reading_level: short sentences, one joke per beat at most

style.narration: none or dry one-liners as captions

signature.why: The humour sits on top of a real calculation, which is the part that is hard to copy.
elements: The question is stated as a lab request form in the first second.
'Assumptions' card, played straight, listing what was assumed (a spherical cow is allowed if it is declared).
The answer always arrives as a number with a unit and a comparison to something familiar.
A recurring object (a rubber duck) appears somewhere in every scene for scale.

cta.pinned_comment: Pick next week's question from the replies.
avoid: claims that the absurd scenario is possible

seo.title_pattern: What if <absurd premise>? (we did the maths)

accuracy_policy.label_fiction: Anything imagined is labelled as an assumption on screen.
